PASS confirmed contact stores real vector and returns defensive state
PASS reject invalid contacts and synthetic Drive children
PASS duplicate IDs cannot refresh age or bank again after consumption
PASS footplant min interval and five slots
PASS full bank nonrun replaces only oldest running contact
PASS clock freezes during inactive simulation and expiry has exact boundary
PASS release validates frame and mode before consumption
PASS obstruction and callback failures are atomic
PASS successful release spends one ID and confirms actual delta to sweep
PASS perfect timing is inclusive sixty ms and imperfect keeps seventy percent
PASS directional and launch redirect recorded energy without inventing magnitude
PASS midair launch spends a previously grounded captured jump
PASS rail release needs attachment and actual tangent
PASS brake never reverses velocity or creates speed from rest
PASS auto selects grounded launch and attached rail
PASS ghoststep needs input and costs ten before timing discount
PASS DoubleStep second perfect beat is320ms after first
PASS DoubleStep valid imperfect second release remains seventy percent
PASS demanding releases block at85 strain without spending
PASS release cannot exceed capacity100
PASS recovery waits1.5s after release then recovers8 per active second

PASS hero switch clears transient bank while preserving strain
PASS core clamps release delta to safe28 even for large real impulses
PASS reservations are atomic, block ordinary release, and never refresh expiry
PASS reserved footplants cannot be replaced and expired reservations cannot release
PASS events stay monotonic across reset and output cannot mutate core
PASS callback cannot mutate proposed delta or reenter and double spend
PASS invalid and negative dt cannot corrupt clock
PASS launch rejects generic upward contacts and accepts only captured launch actions
PASS reorientation is limited to sixty degrees inclusive

PASS Ghoststep accepts captured forward footplant within sixty degrees

PASS already expired contact cannot replace an existing running impulse
